[[Template:FirefoxPrivacyNotice]]
Firefox balances privacy with performance by collecting limited data, such as usage trends, crash reports, and system details, to improve stability and functionality. 

This article provides an overview of what’s included in your system settings, where you can control data collection and usage on desktop; guidance is also available for [[Mobile - Manage Firefox data collection and privacy settings|mobile]].

__TOC__

=Manage settings involving data collection on desktop=
To manage technical and interaction data, studies, the daily usage ping and the automatic sending of crash reports:

==First, open Firefox settings for data collection and use==
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#On the left-hand side, click {for not fx152}{menu Privacy & Security}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Permissions and data}{/for}.
#Scroll down to the {for not fx151}'''Firefox Data Collection and Use'''{/for}{for fx151}'''Firefox data collection and use'''{/for} section.
#;{for not fx148}[[Image:Fx140esrDataCollection]]{/for}{for =fx148, =fx149, =fx150}[[Image:Fx148DataCollection]]{/for}{for =fx151}[[Image:Fx151DataCollection]]{/for}{for fx152}[[Image:Fx152settings-DataCollection]]{/for}

==Next, choose what to share==
Uncheck or check the following options based on your preferences:
*'''Send technical and interaction data to Mozilla''' – Helps improve Firefox features, performance and stability. For details, see [[Manage technical and interaction data collection settings in Firefox]].<br>''This setting also enables the following two options:''
**'''Allow personalized extension recommendations''' – Provides tailored extension suggestions.
**{for not fx151}'''Install and run studies'''{/for}{for fx151}'''Allow Firefox to run feature studies'''{/for}  – Allows Mozilla to test experimental features before public release. For details, see [[About Studies]].
{for fx148}
*'''Allow Firefox to improve features, performance, and stability between updates''' - Lets Firefox automatically install  fixes and feature changes. For details, see [[Manage remote improvements settings in Firefox]].
{/for}
*'''Send daily usage ping to Mozilla''' – Helps Mozilla estimate the number of active users. For details, see [[Manage daily usage ping data collection settings in Firefox]].
*'''Automatically send crash reports''' – Sends crash data to help diagnose and fix browser issues. For details, see [[Crash reports in Firefox for Desktop]].
{note}'''Note:''' Changes save automatically. Close the Settings tab when you're done.{/note}

=Manage sponsored content data, recent activity and weather=
==First, open the New Tab content settings==
Click the {for not fx141}gear [[Image:Fx89Personalize-GearIcon]]{/for}{for fx141}pencil [[Image:Fx141NewTabCustomizeIcon]]{/for} icon on the bottom right corner of your [[New Tab page in Firefox|New Tab page]]. A panel will open, showing content you can customize.

==Next, choose your New Tab content==
Click the toggle next to a section to switch it on [[Image:Fx89Personalize-ToggleOn]] or off [[Image:Fx89Personalize-ToggleOff]] to show or hide that section.
*'''Weather''' – Provides the ability to turn on or off the weather widget. For details, see [[Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page#w_weather|Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page - Weather]].
*'''Shortcuts''' – Provides the ability to turn on or off shortcuts on the New Tab page. For details, see [[Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page#w_shortcuts|Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page - Shortcuts]].
*'''Recommended stories''' – Provides the ability to turn on or off recommended stories on the New Tab page. For details, see [[Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page#w_recommended-stories|Customize items on your Firefox New Tab page - Recommended stories]].
;{for not fx145}[[Image:Fx140PersonalizeNewTab-NoWallpaper|width=300]]{/for}{for fx145}[[Image:Fx145CustomizeNewTab-NoWallpaper|width=300]]{/for}
